final: WITH channel_counts AS (SELECT o.orderbase AS channel, AVG(e.fillcount) AS avg_fillcount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS distinct_orders FROM orderexecutions AS e JOIN orders AS o ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.orderbase) SELECT channel, avg_fillcount, distinct_orders, 1.0 * distinct_orders / SUM(distinct_orders) OVER () AS order_fraction FROM channel_counts
